answer_2.quote: Accuracy of the state of the art solvers increases after training on the proposed augmented dataset

answer_4.quote: To verify the quality of augmented examples, we conduct human evaluation. The focus of this evaluation is: (1) To check if the augmentations will result in the same linear equation as present in the original problem statement, (2) To evaluate if the numerical values for each augmentation example is preserved, (3) Evaluate each sample in the range 0 to 1 for its semantic similarity with the original problem statement, (4) On a scale of 1 to 5 rate each augmented example for its grammatical correctness
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators rate augmented examples based on equation preservation, number preservation, semantic similarity (0-1 scale), and grammatical correctness (1-5 scale)
